lines: There are 2,450 meters of mountain above this train.
It's the Gotthard Base Tunnel in Switzerland. 57 kilometers long, the longest railway tunnel in the world.
At its deepest point, there are 2,450 meters of mountain above the trains.
Inside, the rock reached 46 degrees Celsius before ventilation.
Builders removed 28 million tonnes of rock. Work started in 1999, and it opened in 2016.
The result is the first flat route through the Alps, never higher than 549 meters.
Follow for a new megaproject every day.
